scope: Normal ARCB adoption of synthesized guitar, bass and drums; no replacement recording and no new source separation.

harmony.reason_to_reject_broad_trial: CQT windows on dense strums can contain adjacent harmony; actual same-bank output was mixed. Require 120 ms guards on both sides and stronger template evidence.
limits: No new attacks; bass, drums, vocals and score clock unchanged.
Other includes separation bleed; confidence is not ground truth.
Verify actual browser output with independent STFT pitch-class analysis.

bass_recheck.method: Existing bass stems: strongest stereo channel, 11025 Hz, order-3 28-1200 Hz bandpass; YIN MIDI24-60, 2048 frame, hop128. Inspect +55ms to min(end-25ms,start+0.5s); at least 3 frames.
bass_recheck.candidate_rule: At least .85 of frames within 30 cents, median RMS > .003, pitch differs from score. Short observations are not sufficient to replace notes.

drum_recheck.method: band-limited spectral-flux reference vs transcription rows at fitted BPM

reference_detector.calibration: Factors calibrated on Human Fly bars 9–16 against the prior class-count envelope and inspected transcription alignment; exploratory, not independent ground-truth labels.

limits: High-band transients include cymbal, snare bleed and separation artifacts; not verified hat labels.
Rows and light thinning, not captured Band Room WebAudio; kit attack and section hints excluded.
No detector-latency or per-bar alignment applied. Human Fly has about +27 ms candidate-minus-flux offset; raw ±30 ms F1 is diagnostic only.

guitar_output.scope: Actual guitar-only post-master REC versus other, stereo channel power averaged.

method.representation: Linear STFT pitch-class power; no CQT/HPSS/chord template
method.pitch_class_order: C C# D D# E F F# G G# A A# B

caveats: Other contains other instruments and separation bleed; it is not isolated guitar truth.
Pitch-class energy depends on timbre and harmonic overtones; it cannot certify exact roots, octaves or chord accuracy.
The captured output is actual audio, but comparison is aggregate rather than sample-aligned.
These short windows do not certify all accepted bars, subjective quality or iPhone performance.

mix_output.scope: Actual post-master instrumental mix; original drums+bass+other recombined by the app. Melody guide excluded in both comparisons.
caveats: Relative band powers are level-normalized; dynamics and level are separate measurements.
Stem bleed is not instrument ground truth. Recombining three stems can retain vocal leakage and separation artifacts.
REC/seek times have small encoding and control delays; this is not sample-aligned waveform fidelity.
A quiet interval can be musical: check against the original before calling it a dropout.
No listening-quality score, pitch/chord accuracy claim, or physical iPhone measurement.

browser.scope: Desktop Chromium, 390px viewport. Not physical iPhone or human listening certification.
browser.console_limits: Pre-gesture Tone warnings and a local favicon 404 remain; page exceptions are measured separately.

limits: Original recordings and separation bleed are unchanged. These are finite modal/spectral instruments, not measured models of the particular original instruments.
Broad-band and pitch-class distributions are diagnostics, not note accuracy or perceived realism. Mixed results remain and original high-frequency content is often underrepresented.
Guitar control/candidate comparison used the same preceding .14 guitar normalization in both arms; final band calibration uses .12. It is an isolated harmony diagnostic, not a final mix comparison.
No new attacks, articulation transcription, vocal reconstruction, octave ground truth or physical-iPhone load guarantee. Bass/drum scores remain unchanged.
